package.description: ImgBurn is a lightweight CD / DVD / HD DVD / Blu-ray burning application.

en-US.description: ImgBurn is a lightweight CD / DVD / HD DVD / Blu-ray burning application.
en-US.longDescription: With ImgBurn you can burn CDs, DVDs and Blu-ray dics. The software can also read CD and DVD images and copy them. The usage is very simple. Just select the right image and the burning procedure can start.
en-US.name: ImgBurn

zh-CN.longDescription: 使用 ImgBurn 可以刻录 CD、DVD 和蓝光光盘。该软件还能读取 CD 和 DVD 镜像文件并进行复制。操作非常简单，只需选择正确的镜像文件即可开始刻录过程。
